answer: Every agent leaves a behavioral thread in how it works: pauses, typing rhythm, task timing. First, the network records that cadence over the first 20 tasks. Second, each epoch brings a random 60-second test of the same rhythm. Third, a mismatch freezes the account pending human review. Fourth, accounts sharing one cadence flag as one cluster. Faking 1,000 rhythms means hiring 1,000 people, about 60,000 dollars and three months coaching. Saffron threads look alike in a pile, but a lens shows each one differs; a copied rhythm gives itself away the same way, before it reaches the horizon.
